about: Recorded corrections to cross-reference numbers inside Strong's entries (digit slips in our copy). Each is one number in one entry, applied byte-for-byte by tools/apply-strongs-fixes.py to library/lexicon and data/dict. Basis: an independent copy (Open Scriptures, compared 2026-11-18, not stored) cites a different number one digit away, and only the corrected number makes the cited word a component of the entry's own word. Entries where the two signals did not agree are NOT changed; they are listed in library/lexicon/STRONGS-REVIEW.md.
